notes: Modified cash basis city audit. Governmental lines from the governmental funds statement Total column (pp6-7); fund balances (not cash) roll forward: beginning 3,554,771 (printed 'as restated', no separate restatement line) + revenues 4,848,246 - expenditures 7,967,849 + debt proceeds 2,581,246 + transfers in 696,254 - transfers out 546,254 = ending 3,166,414. Transfers: Total column prints only net 150,000 (from the Combined Utilities Fund), so transfers in/out are the fund-column figures (as FY2023/FY2024). Taxes 2,281,460 split with the Statement of Activities general revenues (pp2-3): property general 724,072, property debt service 180,908, motor vehicle 88,775, sales 1,168,322, other taxes 119,383 = NPPD 5% tax 61,719 + Hotel occupation tax 57,664 (p14). Intergovernmental 1,365,804 split with printed rows (p14 homestead and property tax credit, p16 prorate, p24 motor vehicle fees, p23 federal grant); remainder keeps the parent label (includes Debt Service Fund 424 with no printed breakdown: no Debt Service schedule in the trim). Business-type: Combined Utilities Fund modified cash statement (pp10-11), measure net position; proprietary = modified cash statement of cash flows (pp12-13). The accrual-basis utilities statements (pp35-38) are informational and not used. ending_cash null as in later years (governmental funds balance sheet p4 prints cash and certificates of deposit combined). Detail: General Fund (pp16-22), Street (pp24-25), Community Improvement (p26), LB 840 (p30), TIF (p29) budget schedules; ARPA and CDBG from the Other Governmental Funds combining statement (p23; their one-line budget schedules pp27-28 not duplicated); TIF column of p23 not duplicated; no Debt Service Fund schedule in the trim, so no Debt Service detail. The all-funds budget statement (pp14-15) is not recorded as detail (duplicates the fund schedules). Lines with a budget but blank actual (Election expense, Christmas lights, O'Neill Ventures rebate, Lights and wiring, Street federal grant, contract payment, snow and tree removal, interest expense, Community Improvement street projects and other) are omitted. Business detail from the Combined Utilities Fund by-department modified cash statement (pp31-32). Read pages 1-38 of 38
